features.title: Account identity and profile editor
features.expected: The account identity is separate from the default birth chart. Name, linked contact and avatar are editable without renaming a kundali.

features.title: Settings sections and destinations
features.expected: Account, App, Help and About expose equivalent user tasks, with unavailable paid services hidden.

features.title: Restore Purchases entry point
features.expected: A Restore Purchases action must reach an actual store restoration flow with visible outcomes.

features.title: One to five people in a conversation
features.expected: Select one to five charts; Done applies the draft, cancelled edits do not alter the active conversation.

features.title: Questions respond to the selection
features.expected: Six single-person starters and six group starters use all selected names; server follow-ups replace initial templates.

features.title: Evidence, confidence and saved history
features.expected: An evidence row identifies the person whose chart supports it, even after reopening a conversation.

features.title: Read aloud and answer controls
features.expected: Manual Play plus an opt-in automatic reading control; stop correctly on disable, new conversation and exit.

features.title: Conversation layout and accessibility
features.expected: Ordinary-size starter placement and selection summary agree; large text remains readable.

features.title: Phone and email authentication
features.expected: Phone/email entry, six-digit OTP, returning-user restoration and sign-out must reach the same account.

features.title: Welcome, numerology and birth-data sequence
features.expected: Users provide equivalent required data and see equivalent reveal content before entering the app.

features.title: Google and Apple sign-in reachability
features.expected: Only working, reachable identity providers should be exposed in production.

features.title: Saved charts and default person
features.expected: Changes to a selected birth chart must reach every reading and survive account restoration.

features.title: Add a kundali from a contact
features.expected: Import chosen contact details only after a user action and allow corrections before saving.

features.title: Digital credits and purchase recovery
features.expected: Show the same balance/ledger, validate store purchases on the server and recover pending grants without duplicates.

features.title: Charging for a generated kundali
features.expected: Charge once for a new generation; reopening cached results and failed/cancelled attempts follow the shared wallet contract.

features.title: Remote feature flags
features.expected: A remote rollout change should produce consistent user-visible features on both apps.

features.title: Push delivery and tap routing
features.expected: Enabled notifications arrive and open the same destination, with correct account and timezone.

features.title: Notification preferences and quiet hours
features.expected: Engine topics/cadence, quiet hours and timezone stay synchronized with the server.

features.title: Dashboard cards and arrangement
features.expected: Users can access the same enabled cards and retain their chosen arrangement.

features.title: Birthday prompts
features.expected: Today's birthday is computed for the default and saved people, using equivalent date and dismissal rules.

features.title: Daily, weekly and monthly horoscope
features.expected: Person selection and period changes show the appropriate reading/facets, with honest unavailable states.

features.title: Kundali and person page
features.expected: Equivalent chart positions, identities and supported sections for the same birth data.

features.title: Panchang and chogadiya
features.expected: Selected place/date drives the same five limbs, auspicious periods and day/night interpretation.

features.title: KP system and Lal Kitab
features.expected: Same chosen person, data tables, navigation and explain actions.

features.title: Numerology numbers, grids and interpretation
features.expected: Same birth/name/mobile inputs produce matching numeric facts and equivalent explanations.

features.title: Two-person compatibility
features.expected: Same two charts yield the same numeric breakdown, explain context and share/export behavior.

features.title: Multi-Match ranking and verdicts
features.expected: Stable ranking from deterministic numbers; authored verdicts explain rather than calculate.

features.title: Deterministic reasoning contract
features.expected: Device computes facts and bands; the server phrases grounded claims, without inventing calculations.

features.title: Explain a section in context
features.expected: Explain requests refer to the actual person/section on screen and use the selected language.

features.title: Palm photo, consent and saved reading
features.expected: Explicit consent before sending a photo, honest progress/failure and recoverable saved results.

features.title: Face photo and reading variants
features.expected: Supported reading variants load from selected images and survive interruption without duplicate requests.

features.title: Prediction and birth-time rectification
features.expected: Same inputs, supported modes and honest result/error states.

features.title: PDF generation and sharing
features.expected: Equivalent report choices, locale/chart style, progress and readable exported content.

features.title: Languages and runtime reading labels
features.expected: All exposed locales translate chrome, reading labels and request locale consistently.

features.title: Five themes and accessibility
features.expected: Theme intent, readable contrast and controls remain consistent without forcing identical native widgets.

features.title: Remedies, astrologers and bookings
features.expected: Same service availability, booking confirmation, paid-state recovery and order history under the same rollout.

features.title: Consultation calls and recovery
features.expected: Equivalent audio/video choice, permissions, ringing, reconnect/end, ratings and consultation summary.

features.title: Shake-to-report and content reporting
features.expected: A user can file a report, attach evidence and get a visible result independent of QA runs.

features.title: Home-screen widgets
features.expected: Supported widgets show fresh data and tap into the matching app destination.

features.title: Shared data, navigation and recovery
features.expected: Both apps preserve account isolation, API contracts and recoverable loading/error behavior.
